Northern-Hemisphere upright convention: illuminated right while waxing and left while waning. The same Moon repeats,not8simultaneous bodies or extra meanings. Half the sphere is illuminated; apparent fraction changes with viewing geometry,NOT Earth shadow. No orbit inset or suggestion of eclipses every new/full Moon. An introduced nontext tactile key uses2 horizontal interior hatch strokes for illuminated material/appearance and no hatches for new; hatches are not physical lunar stripes, photons,brightness units or inherent touch meaning. Intermediate phase terminator segments follow the true projected ellipse/diameter but intentionally stop at y=+/-0.70R, leaving declared gaps before the full limb for nominal clarity; underlying complete illumination-domain formula remains explicit. Hatches stay strictly within that formula-defined illuminated domain and clear printed boundaries. External accessible key supplies phase names,clockwise/return order and illumination code; no visible lettering/Braille.700mm square illustrative nominal guide,not device/page fit,calibrated tactile,recognition or photometric evidence.459/76/287 sources inform context,not exact label/orbit reconstruction."}, {"type": "Index graphic line-dot alternative", "scope": "Index1.2mm GRAPHIC LINE DOTS are a declared medium alternative, not Braille or extra bodies, scenes, brightness units or phase/equilibrium states. Whole semantic glyphs, where present, retain their separately checked full native envelopes of at least6mm. Global rounded centres at least3.1mm and each native path interval at most6.2mm; true contacts, corners and native extrema protected. No physical tracing or learner-recognition approval.", "actual_phase_choices": []}], "source_limit": "ONE cyclic programme of8 equal-size apparent-disc fields in clockwise order from top: new,waxing crescent,first quarter,waxing gibbous,full,waning gibbous,third quarter,waning crescent,return to new. Northern-Hemisphere upright convention: illuminated right while waxing and left while waning. The same Moon repeats,not8simultaneous bodies or extra meanings. Half the sphere is illuminated; apparent fraction changes with viewing geometry,NOT Earth shadow. No orbit inset or suggestion of eclipses every new/full Moon. An introduced nontext tactile key uses2 horizontal interior hatch strokes for illuminated material/appearance and no hatches for new; hatches are not physical lunar stripes, photons,brightness units or inherent touch meaning. Intermediate phase terminator segments follow the true projected ellipse/diameter but intentionally stop at y=+/-0.70R, leaving declared gaps before the full limb for nominal clarity; underlying complete illumination-domain formula remains explicit. Hatches stay strictly within that formula-defined illuminated domain and clear printed boundaries. External accessible key supplies phase names,clockwise/return order and illumination code; no visible lettering/Braille.700mm square illustrative nominal guide,not device/page fit,calibrated tactile,recognition or photometric evidence.459/76/287 sources inform context,not exact label/orbit reconstruction. Illustrative nominal700x700mm page; device/page fit, touch and recognition remain pending.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}

g.data-exception-reason: Index1.2mm GRAPHIC LINE DOTS are a declared medium alternative, not Braille or extra bodies, scenes, brightness units or phase/equilibrium states. Whole semantic glyphs, where present, retain their separately checked full native envelopes of at least6mm. Global rounded centres at least3.1mm and each native path interval at most6.2mm; true contacts, corners and native extrema protected. No physical tracing or learner-recognition approval.
